{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

::: remark

A measure assigns a size to each set in a
[collection of sets](sets-functions.qmd#def-collection):
how many elements it has, how long it is, or how likely it is.
This page builds measures from $\sigma$-algebras and additivity,
using the [sets and functions](sets-functions.qmd) page's definitions.
A probability measure is a measure $P$ on a set $\Omega$
whose value on $\Omega$ itself is $P(\Omega) = 1$,
so that the probability that some outcome in $\Omega$ occurs is 1;
the Morrison Lab's probability notes build on that definition
([probability measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)).

:::
